summary: Data base for hernia surgery at our university medical center. The retrospective evaluation of the clinical data will generate hypotheses for prospective clinical trials.

interventions.name:
Data base - Hernia Surgery University Medical Center - University of Freiburg
The aim of the study is to generate and maintain a data base for hernia surgery at our university medical center. The retrospective evaluation of the clinical data will generate hypotheses for prospective clinical trials.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patient underwent hernia surgery (Groin- and/or ventral hernia repair) since 01.01.2018
Exclusion criteria:
- Age < 18 years
- patients with financial dependence on the principal investigator/employees of the University Hospital Freiburg
- legally incapacitated patients / prisoners
